$comment: AI Champs research tracks. The research hub reads this file; the daily research task reads scope, categories, criteria and watch keywords to know what to look for.

tracks.question: What already exists for running, comparing and benchmarking AI coding-agent harnesses in isolated sandboxes, which parts can Azm adopt, and what is left to build?
scope: Coding-agent harnesses: SDLC/team harnesses (ticket to release) and agent runtimes (the engine inside).
Harness evaluation and benchmarking: frameworks, public benchmarks, and methods for scoring harnesses on your own code.
Sandboxes: isolated execution for agents, managed and self-hosted.
Observability and governance needed to measure and control agent runs.
Commercial cloud coding agents, as baselines to compare against.
assumptions: "Harness sandbox" = a place where Azm can run any harness (squad-kit, azm-harness, or others) on real Azm tasks in isolation, and measure quality, cost, speed and standards compliance.
Research phase: open source and paid tools are both in scope; budget is available.
Every model and agent is allowed for now.
The result must be general: it should work for every team, configured per project with YAML in the future.

desc.en: Take work from a ticket or idea to a reviewed PR or release, with roles, gates and human approval.
desc.ar: تنقل العمل من التذكرة أو الفكرة إلى طلب دمج مُراجَع أو إصدار، مع أدوار وبوابات وموافقة بشرية.

desc.en: The agent engine a harness drives: CLIs, SDKs and hosted harnesses.
desc.ar: محرك الوكيل الذي يشغّله الـ harness: أدوات سطر الأوامر وحزم SDK والـ harness المستضافة.

desc.en: Run harnesses on task sets and score them: frameworks, benchmarks, harness optimizers.
desc.ar: تشغيل الـ harness على مجموعات مهام وتقييمها: أُطر ومقاييس معيارية وأدوات تحسين.

desc.en: Isolated environments where agents run code: cloud, BYOC and self-hosted.
desc.ar: بيئات معزولة يشغّل فيها الوكلاء الشيفرة: سحابية، وداخل حسابك السحابي، ومستضافة ذاتيًا.

desc.en: Tracing, cost, policies, secrets and security scanning around agent runs.
desc.ar: التتبّع والتكلفة والسياسات والأسرار والفحص الأمني حول تشغيل الوكلاء.

desc.en: Vendor-hosted coding agents used as baselines.
desc.ar: وكلاء برمجة يستضيفهم المزوّد، يُستخدمون مرجعًا للمقارنة.

desc.en: How directly it serves the harness sandbox goal.
desc.ar: مدى خدمته المباشرة لهدف بيئة الاختبار.
الانتشار ووتيرة الإصدارات والجهة الداعمة والتوثيق.

desc.en: License, self-hosting, data control, no lock-in.
desc.ar: الترخيص والاستضافة الذاتية والتحكم في البيانات وعدم الارتهان لمزوّد.

desc.en: Works with many agents and models, not one vendor.
desc.ar: يعمل مع وكلاء ونماذج كثيرة لا مع مزوّد واحد.

desc.en: Declarative config (YAML/files) a team can own and version.
desc.ar: إعدادات تصريحية (YAML/ملفات) يملكها الفريق ويضبط نسخها.

desc.en: Exposes results, traces, cost and metrics we can compare.
desc.ar: يعرض نتائج وتتبّعًا وتكلفة ومقاييس قابلة للمقارنة.

adopt.en: Use it as a building block

adopt-part.en: Reuse a part or pattern of it
adopt-part.ar: نعيد استخدام جزء منه أو نمطه

benchmark.en: Benchmark against it in the sandbox

tracks.question: How do other organizations package AI development standards (skills, rules, workflows), make them configurable per project, and track adoption?
scope: Standard formats: AGENTS.md, Agent Skills (SKILL.md), plugins and marketplaces, rules files.
Methodologies that ship as packages: Spec Kit, BMAD, Superpowers, AI-DLC, Kiro specs and others.
Distribution and versioning of standards across many repositories.
Measuring adoption and compliance per project.

tracks.question: What are the options for a shared knowledge base across dev centers that serves both developers and AI agents?
scope: Agent memory and knowledge layers (graph, vector, file-based).
Code and documentation intelligence: code graphs, wikis, search.
Enterprise knowledge platforms and MCP servers that expose knowledge to agents.
